name: Vitreous-Corrie
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against tidally locked hemisphere, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Forests of black-leaved flora drink the dim light and exhale a scent like cold iron.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
